channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Spider-Man Brand New Day Box Office Day 1: Tom Holland film opens strong, eyes ₹70 cr net in India
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day collected ₹60.60 crore net in India on its opening day, with the Tom Holland film recording strong turnout across languages and posting an estimated ₹72.44 crore gross.

item.title: PM Modi drops late-night selfie video after anti-paper leak Bill gets Parliament’s nod, says 'exam mafias won't be spare
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcomed Parliament’s passage of the anti-paper leak Bill, calling it a major step towards a credible examination system and warning that organised exam fraud networks would face strict action.

item.title: Bryan Johnson says he may have gone ‘too far’ with longevity experiment after autoimmune gastritis diagnosis
item.description: Bryan Johnson, the tech entrepreneur who has spent years and millions of dollars trying to slow ageing, says he is now questioning whether his longevity experiment has gone too far.

item.title: Jaishankar tells Ukraine FM Black Sea attacks on Indian seafarers 'absolutely unacceptable'
item.description: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar on Thursday conveyed to his Ukrainian counterpart Andrii Sybiha that attacks on commercial shipping and Indian seafarers in Black Sea by any party are ‘absolutely unacceptable.’

item.title: No European team in football World Cup? President Gianni Infantino softens stance as UEFA mulls boycotting FIFA events
item.description: UEFA, representing 55 nations, may boycott FIFA tournaments if President Gianni Infantino pursues controversial selloff plans. A crisis meeting revealed that no UEFA teams would join FIFA competitions.

item.title: E20 petrol can reduce fuel economy by 2-6%: Nitin Gadkari
item.description: Petrol blended with 20% ethanol (E20) can reduce fuel economy by 2 to 6% depending on the vehicle category and vintage, Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari informed Parliament today.

item.title: Kusha Kapila's Underneat co-founder left ₹3 crore job to travel the world: 'People said I was crazy'
item.description: Reflecting on his career before taking the break, he said his work routine had become all-consuming. For 13 years, he spent most of his time at work.

item.title: Jared Leto refutes sexual assault allegations made by 10 women in BBC documentary: ‘Absolutely and categorically false'
item.description: The documentary, 'Jared Leto: Hollywood's Darkest Secret', released on Wednesday, features allegations from 10 women, all of whom levelled serious accusations against the actor and musician.

item.title: India's ‘top-ranked’ airport has zero flights, won’t resume operation before October: Social media reacts
item.description: The airport ranks highest in India's Customer Satisfaction Index despite hosting no flights since July. Experts question whether such rankings should also consider connectivity and traffic in addition to service quality.

item.title: ‘Amit Shah should definitely resign’: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke backs Rahul Gandhi's demand over police action
item.description: Dipke’s demand came a day after Congress leader Rahul Gandhi accused Shah of ordering the crackdown on the protesters and demanded his resignation. He said he seconded Gandhi.

item.title: Can ‘exceptional circumstances’ justify the use of pellet guns on protesters? What Supreme Court said
item.description: A bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi and Justice V Mohana noted that police personnel are permitted to use pellet guns in exceptional situations under the BPRD advisory. The bench described the plea seeking a complete ban on their use as 'vague'.

item.title: US-Iran War: PM Modi chairs high-level security review meeting - What was discussed?
item.description: Prime Minister discussed with a group of senior ministers the prevailing global security situation and how to maintain supply chain uninterrupted despite conflicts in different zones, including the Strait of Hormuz, the Black Sea, the Red Sea, and the Gulf of Aden.

item.title: GSTN again defers e-Way Bill changes ahead of 1 August rollout
item.description: The move puts on hold mandatory Ship-To GSTIN reporting and the voluntary e-Way Bill closure facility, allowing businesses and GST software providers to continue operating under the existing framework until further notice.

item.title: Chhota Rajan convicted as CBI court sentences him to 7 years in fake passport case; here's what the probe revealed
item.description: A special CBI court in Chennai sentenced gangster Chhota Rajan to seven years for obtaining a passport with forged documents. The conviction followed 22 years of legal proceedings, confirming he used the identity of Vijaya Kadam to secure the passport.

item.title: Over 200 academics criticise Priyanka Gandhi over 'gaumutra' remark on IIT professor: 'Whether intended as sarcasm...'
item.description: In the open letter, the academicians said Parliament should remain a forum where ideas are debated with dignity and individuals are evaluated on the merit of their arguments rather than through caricatures.

item.title: Saurav Das’ single-word reaction to Supreme Court’s decision on pellet guns sparks outrage, ‘Face the consequence’
item.description: Saurav Das' single-word response to the Supreme Court's ruling on pellet guns has ignited controversy. The court allows their use under specific circumstances.

item.title: Monsoon weather: Are schools open or closed tomorrow in India as IMD predicts heavy rainfall in various states?
item.description: Heavy rainfall is expected due to the active southwest monsoon. While Punjab has announced a public holiday, schools in the Khordha district of Odisha are scheduled to remain closed tomorrow on 31 July. Check details

item.title: Kanwar Yatra 2026: Delhi-Meerut Expressway closure, Delhi-Haridwar highway restrictions; check alternate routes
item.description: Delhi Police said vehicular movement is expected to be affected on several roads in the capital's western districts due to the movement of Kanwariyas.

item.title: ‘Mera desh badal raha hai’: School kids protest, demand more teachers; CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke shares video | Watch
item.description: Students in the video demand the appointment of more teachers due to a severe shortage affecting education, prompting protests. They emphasise their rights and call for government action.

item.title: Govt says E20 petrol does not damage engines, credits ethanol blending for fuel price stability
item.description: The Centre says extensive studies and real-world data show E20 petrol does not cause abnormal engine wear or reduce vehicle life. It also credits ethanol blending with improving energy security and helping keep fuel prices lower despite global crude oil spikes.

item.title: Deep depression may bring extremely heavy rainfall to central, western India: IMD
item.description: A dozen states face low-to-moderate flash flood warnings and waterlogging as the weather system moves across Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Gujarat, the weather office said.

item.title: Japan sees 17th consecutive year of population decline. Why is the country failing to reverse the trend?
item.description: Japan's population of Japanese nationals falls below 120 million for the first time in 42 years, marking a 17th straight year of decline. Despite childcare support, cash incentives and even AI-powered matchmaking, the country is struggling to reverse its demographic crisis.

item.title: ‘Active site for peaceful demonstrations’: Delhi Police denies rumors claiming Jantar Mantar is closed for protests
item.description: Delhi Police dismissed social media rumors about Jantar Mantar being closed for protests, stating it is an authorized site for demonstrations. Protests require permission from authorities, with a limit of 1,000 participants as per Supreme Court guidelines.

item.title: SpaceX gets $1.6 billion Space Force order: How much of America's Golden Dome could depend on Elon Musk's company?
item.description: SpaceX wins a $1.6 billion US Space Force contract to launch 18 Falcon 9 missions through 2027, strengthening its role in America's $185 billion Golden Dome missile defence programme. Here's how Elon Musk's company is becoming central to the project.

item.title: Charanjit Singh Channi Faridkot rally: Former Punjab CM leads dharna against AAP govt over Pharmacy officer exam row
item.description: Charanjit Singh Channi Faridkot rally: Former Punjab CM led protest against Bhagwant Mann-led AAP govt over Pharmacy officer cheating exam controversy. Among the seven Congress MPs from Punjab, Channi was the sole member who was not present in the House during Rahul Gandhi's speech in Lok Sabha.

item.title: West Bengal: Over ₹50 crore in cash and gold recovered from bus driver’s house after Birbhum Police’s raid
item.description: Authorities seized over ₹50 crore in cash and gold from Minar Mondal's home, with the cash concealed in hidden cupboards. Investigation reveals a shift from cash to gold for easier storage.

item.title: Damietta port attack: Egypt rules out accident, says drone strike caused fire aboard 2 gas vessels
item.description: The drone hit the floating storage tanker Energos Winter, sparking a fire that later spread to another vessel, Gaslog Salem.

item.title: Why is Ukraine attacking Wildberries, the Russian version of Amazon, selling everything from groceries to drones?
item.description: Wildberries, Russia's largest online retailer, is under attack from Ukrainian drones, leading to operational disruptions and potential government aid requests. The company's recent changes in vendor agreements may shield it from financial repercussions, but sellers face dire consequences.

item.title: Why Saudi Arabia finally joined the US war on Iran: What's changed after months of restraint
item.description: Saudi Arabia joins US strikes on Iran-backed militias after months of avoiding direct involvement. Riyadh cites repeated drone attacks on its energy infrastructure and growing threats from Iran-backed proxies, signalling a shift from restraint to military deterrence.

item.title: ‘Mujahideen trained by us in the past hang around our necks’: Pak PM aide's stunning admission amid PoJK unrest | Watch
item.description: Protesters continued to stage demonstrations on Thursday at D-Chowk in Rawalakot in PoJK after social media accounts associated with JKJAAC alleged that security forces used lethal force against demonstrators, resulting in fatalities.

item.title: ‘I have made mistakes’: Ajinkya Rahane chokes in emotion while announcing his retirement | Watch
item.description: Ajinkya Rahane has retired from international cricket, announcing the decision immediately. Emphasising the integrity of his career, he expressed pride in contributing to Indian cricket's growth and said he plans to mentor future players.&nbsp;

item.title: Severe rainfall alert: IMD forecasts heavy rainfall in Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, parts of Odisha amid monsoon
item.description: Severe rainfall alert: IMD has predicted heavy to very heavy rainfall, along with thunderstorms, at isolated locations across Assam. For Uttarakhand, it has issued an orange alert for Thursday, warning of heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places in the state.

item.title: Gaganyaan mission update: Govt unveils details, says Ganganyatris training in Bengaluru as first uncrewed launch nears
item.description: Union Minister Jitendra Singh told Parliament that “activities are in progress towards the accomplishment of the first uncrewed mission, G1”.

item.title: Sonam Wangchuk hails Vande Bharat Express as he travels to Srinagar from New Delhi, reminds Centre to fulfil promises
item.description: The activist also made an appeal to the central government wherein he asked the latter to keep the promises it had made both to Wangchuk as well as the Cockroach Janta Party.

item.title: Union Minister Jitendra Singh introduces Public Examinations Amendment Bill 2026 in Rajya Sabha amid Oppn uproar
item.description: Union Minister Jitendra Singh introduced the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026, in Rajya Sabha after it was cleared by the Lok Sabha amid ongoing debates over examination integrity and police actions against protesters.
